blocks.title: Etesian on KDE Plasma, in detail.
blocks.lead: What the Plasma desktop gets, and how to install it from source for the current user. It installs from source; there are no packages.
blocks.intro: Plasma 6.6 (Kubuntu 26.04) or newer. From a clone of the repository:
steps: `./install.sh` for the look and behaviour; your panels stay as they are.
`./install.sh --layout` also sets up the Etesian menu bar and dock.
Log out and back in once.
`./uninstall.sh` puts everything back as it was.

items.title: Touchpad
items.text: Pinch with three fingers to zoom the windows view; swipe sideways with three fingers to minimise.

blocks.heading: Limits
paragraphs: Your own calendars need KDE PIM. Kate, KWrite, Dolphin, Okular and Gwenview get their toolbars in the header; other apps keep their own.
Apps outside Etesian's icon set (it covers about two thousand: the KDE apps, LibreOffice and the common desktop ones) keep their own icons.

home.title: Etesian for KDE Plasma.
home.lead: Etesian on KDE Plasma brings the same calm design language from your phone to your laptop or desktop. It builds from source right inside your user account—no root required—and if you ever uninstall it, your original panels and settings come right back.

images.alt: Dolphin and Kate with the Etesian header bar, the global menu and the dock
images.caption: Windows with their actions in the header bar, the global menu on top and the dock on the left.

images.alt: The Overview: Events on the left, open windows in the middle, apps and search on the right
images.caption: The Overview: Events, open windows, and search as you type.

images.alt: Belle flip clock, word clock and feeds widgets on the desktop
images.caption: Belle desktop widgets: flip clock, word clock and feeds.

items.title: Actions in the title bar
items.text: A native window decoration: the app’s squircle, its title and its main actions in one header bar. One row of chrome, not two.

items.title: Global menu, clock on the right
items.text: The focused app’s menus on the left; Events, status and the clock on the right.

items.title: A light dock on the left
items.text: Lit squircle icons, live previews of running windows, and an edit mode.

items.title: Snapping
items.text: Drag a window to show numbered zones, or to the top edge for six layouts. Keyboard shortcuts too.

items.title: Events
items.text: The phone’s Events view: the day, weather, notifications, calendar and feeds, sliding in from the right.

items.title: Status menu
items.text: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Silent and Focus, volume and brightness, as on the phone.

items.title: Belle desktop widgets
items.text: Flip clock, word clock, feeds and a mail widget over Thunderbird’s or KMail’s inboxes.

items.title: The whole look
items.text: Colours from the design tokens, N9-style icons for apps, folders and files, the controls inside apps, cursors, sounds, wallpaper, splash and login screen.

items.title: Thunderbird
items.text: An Etesian theme for Thunderbird, generated from the same tokens.

home.caption: The desktop design Etesian for Plasma follows.
